text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that Toronto and East York Community Council establish a Board of Management for the new Yonge and St. Clair Business Improvement Area, appoint directors to the Bloorcourt Village, Bloordale Village, Korea Town, Little Portugal, Mount Pleasant, Ossington Avenue, and Yonge and St. Clair Business Improvement Area Boards of Management and remove directors from The Beach, Bloorcourt Village, Bloordale Village, College West, Korea Town, Little Portugal, Upper Village and Ossington Avenue Business Improvement Area Boards of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Established a Board of Management for the Yonge and St. Clair BIA consisting of thirteen (13) members, including one (1) Councillor (Ward 22 St. Paul's). 2. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area (BIA) Boards of Management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Bloorcourt Village: Perketa, Joe Bloordale Village: Lumsden, Alicia Korea Town: Lee, Matthew Lee, Suki Little Portugal: Gomes, Deolinda Mount Pleasant: McEwen, Jessica Ossington Avenue: Benincasa, Arianna Yonge and St. Clair: Clarke, Kat Fong, Katie Gerry, Steven Goncalves, Mike Hastings, David Huggins, Sarah Keung, Eddie Lo, Amy Myers, Jessica Plitt,…
